explication: This repository distributes prebuilt Poppler for Windows; it does not build Poppler itself. Its documented workflow is to package conda-forge binaries and Poppler data into a ZIP, then make the build available through GitHub Releases for users to download. The README describes these responsibilities, but no source excerpts were provided, so internal implementation details and the exact release wiring are not shown.
